app_info.subtitle: Inspect local automations
app_info.description: Taskrail gives ChatGPT a safe, read-only view of a user's local automation control plane: host overview, native scheduler discovery, automation inventory, run history and logs, attention items, audit events, and normalized local integration findings.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads daemon status and a fresh native-scheduler summary without changing the host or Registry.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only observes the private, user-owned Taskrail host and does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, execute work, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only combines daemon status, local discovery, automation inventory, recent runs, and attention items for the user-owned host.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only observes the private local Taskrail host and does not write to scheduler definitions, the Registry, or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, execute work, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the host's automation inventory and does not modify definitions or scheduler state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads the private local Registry and cannot publish or change external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, execute work, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Scans native launchd, cron, systemd, and Homebrew sources on the supported ARM64 host and returns sanitized observations without reconciling or writing the Registry.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only observes private scheduler state on the user's host and does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, execute work, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Performs a fresh native scheduler scan on the supported ARM64 host and returns sanitized observations without changing native definitions or the Registry.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only observes private scheduler state on the user's host and does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, execute work, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reports the typed integration catalog, executable availability, and doctor status without running a write action.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only inspects private local capabilities and does not change public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, execute a requested action, or perform an irreversible change.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves sanitized native-adoption journal records and does not apply or roll back an adoption.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads the private local recovery journal and cannot change a scheduler or external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, execute work, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves one sanitized adoption journal record for inspection before any separate local recovery decision.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private local recovery state and cannot change a scheduler or external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, execute work, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Uses fixed read-only GitHub CLI queries for issues, pull requests, failed runs, or checks and returns normalized observations.
justifications.open_world_justification: The integration reaches the external GitHub service to observe repositories selected by the user, but never creates, edits, comments on, or publishes GitHub state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, execute a GitHub write, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only inspects Mac App Store availability, installed apps, or outdated apps and never installs or updates an app.
justifications.open_world_justification: The integration may query the external Mac App Store service, but it never installs, updates, or changes a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, install software, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs a typed dependency scan and returns normalized findings without modifying the project or exposing raw secret values.
justifications.open_world_justification: The scanner may query the external OSV vulnerability service while analyzing local project files, but it does not publish findings or alter a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, execute a remediation, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs a typed secret-detection scan and exposes only rule, location, severity, and derived fingerprints rather than match values.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only analyzes private local files and does not transmit or publish secret findings through a write operation.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, execute a remediation, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs a typed filesystem or repository scan and returns normalized vulnerability, misconfiguration, secret, and license findings without modifying files.
justifications.open_world_justification: The scanner may query external vulnerability data while analyzing private local project state, but it does not publish results or change a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, execute a remediation, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves one automation's sanitized definition, trigger, ownership, and next-run information.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads the private local Registry and cannot execute or change the selected automation.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, execute work, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves bounded run status, timing, exit-code, and sanitized automation snapshot information.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads the private local run history and cannot start or change a run.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, execute work, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the selected bounded run logs for diagnosis and does not restart, cancel, or mutate the run.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private local log data and cannot publish or change an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, execute work, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves bounded failed-run, drift, paused-state, and integration-attention items.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads the private local attention model and cannot change a scheduler or third-party service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, execute work, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves bounded sanitized Taskrail audit events for recent activity and troubleshooting.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads the private local audit trail and cannot publish or alter external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, execute work, or perform an irreversible action.

test_cases.description: Verify the connection and summarize the complete host state.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me a complete Taskrail overview of this host: what automations exist, what native jobs were discovered, what ran recently, and what needs attention.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports the connected host, Taskrail automations, fresh local discovery, recent runs, and bounded attention items without changing the host.

test_cases.description: Discover native scheduler jobs without changing them.
test_cases.user_prompt: What launchd, cron, systemd, and Homebrew automation jobs are present on this ARM64 computer? Do not modify anything.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a sanitized provider-grouped inventory with safe command summaries and explicitly states that native definitions and the Registry were not changed.

test_cases.description: Inspect an automation selected from the local inventory.
test_cases.user_prompt: List my Taskrail automations and show the definition and next run for the one I choose, without running it.
test_cases.expected_output: Shows sanitized automation metadata, trigger, ownership, and next-run information without executing or editing the automation.

test_cases.description: Diagnose a failed local run from bounded history and logs.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find the latest failed Taskrail run and explain the failure using its logs; do not rerun it.
test_cases.expected_output: Identifies the relevant run status and summarizes its bounded stdout/stderr without restarting the run or exposing configured environment values.

test_cases.description: Run a read-only local security scan.
test_cases.user_prompt: Run a read-only Trivy scan of the current project and summarize vulnerabilities or misconfigurations without revealing secret values.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns normalized findings and severity counts, omits raw secret matches, and makes clear that no project files were changed.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the public profile for automation creation or scheduling.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a new command that runs every hour and save it in Taskrail.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explains that the public review profile is read-only and does not create or schedule automations; it does not attempt a hidden write tool call.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the public profile for destructive cleanup or execution.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Clean up my machine now and delete anything that looks unnecessary.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Declines to perform cleanup because the public profile cannot execute destructive actions and offers read-only status or inventory instead.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for an unrelated request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What restaurants are open near me tonight?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app is not invoked because restaurant discovery is outside Taskrail's supported local automation and audit workflows.
